description: Fetch a single Polymarket crypto up/down market by market_id or slug from polymarket_search_markets. Provide exactly one of market_id or slug. Other categories, including weather, use REST discovery at /v3/polymarket/markets with an account plan.

coin.description: Crypto asset. Every account plan reaches all seven; only the keyless demo surface is BTC-only.

name: polymarket_get_market
